terminus.status: VEIN REFINED · FORMAL TOOL ≠ OPERATIVE FUNCTION
terminus.finding: The bureaucracy test shows that formal coordination mechanisms may exist without carrying the actual coordination function. A 2016 thesis on Taichung migrant-trafficking enforcement finds inter-agency agreements relying mainly on informal contact channels, while regular coordination meetings have uncertain practical effect and staff face resource scarcity plus routine-work crowding-out. A South Airport community-care presentation independently shows care operating as a relational platform joining volunteers, meals, health checks, learning, spatial reuse and neighborhood ties rather than a single task.
terminus.candidate: Refine institutional habitat into formal apparatus versus operative relational infrastructure. When formal structures are weak or overloaded, functions may migrate into informal contact, situated judgment and relationship work rather than disappear.
terminus.next: seek a case where formalization successfully absorbs relational work without loss as a stronger falsification test

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first scoring, active falsification and function-migration tracking
